description.value:
After years of being outgunned, NCPD’s SWAT requested a new weapon that wouldn’t clash with MAX-TAC’s kill credit. Constitutional Arms responded with the Heavy Auto Rifle (HAR), a hybrid LMG/Battle rifle featuring modernized .30-06 ammo, a 20mm launcher, holosights, and a lightweight bipod. It’s been in service, and getting stolen, since January of 2077.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Machine Gun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Short Scope), Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Non-Basic Ammunition. When rolling for Autofire damage with this weapon, roll 3d6 and drop the lowest roll before applying the multiplier. Requires BODY 8+ to wield unless Mounted.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Short Scope), Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
